import React from 'react'
  import { MDXTag } from '@mdx-js/tag'
  import { Playground } from 'docz';
import { Bootstrap } from './src';
import { Button } from '@rtm-ui/button';
import { DummyComponent } from './dummy-component';

const layoutProps = {
  
};
export default class MDXContent extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props)
    this.layout = null
  }
  render() {
    const { components, ...props } = this.props

    return <MDXTag
             name="wrapper"
             
             components={components}>
<MDXTag name="h1" components={components} props={{"id":"bootstrap"}}>{`Bootstrap`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`The Bootstrap component responsible for the following:`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="ul" components={components}>
<MDXTag name="li" components={components} parentName="ul">{`Rendering the `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="li">{`@rtm-ui/theme`}</MDXTag>{` -> `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="li">{`BootstrapTheme`}</MDXTag>{` component, which sets up all theming
as well as the CSS reset.`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="li" components={components} parentName="ul">{`Proving the `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="li">{`@rtm-ui/tracker`}</MDXTag>{` module with page-specific context for it's
reporting`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="li" components={components} parentName="ul">{`Providing an error boundary. If any `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="li">{`children`}</MDXTag>{` throw an error, the Bootstrap
component will catch it, log it, and show the user an appropriate message.`}</MDXTag>
</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`There will likely be more responsibilities in the future. In general, the
Bootstrap package handles setup and should be the single source of truth
for most "global" needs for a given app.`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="blockquote" components={components}>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components} parentName="blockquote">{`Note: the error handling at this level is extremely minimal as it's the last
possible opportunity to catch an error before the app is entirely unmounted from the
DOM. As a general rule, you should be wrapping most higher-level components (ex. `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`@rtm-ui/plan`}</MDXTag>{`)
with their own error boundaries. You can use the `}<MDXTag name="inlineCode" components={components} parentName="p">{`@rtm-ui/error-boundary`}</MDXTag>{`
package in most cases, or handle roll your own rather easily.`}</MDXTag>
</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Below is an example of a component which errors:`}</MDXTag>
<Playground __codesandbox={`undefined`} __position={0} __code={'<Bootstrap>\n    <DummyComponent />\n  \n</Playground>'} __scope={{props: this ? this.props : props,Bootstrap,Button,DummyComponent}}>
  <Bootstrap>
    <DummyComponent />
  </Bootstrap>
</Playground>
<MDXTag name="p" components={components}>{`Sample usage of tracking for landing page`}</MDXTag>
<MDXTag name="pre" components={components}><MDXTag name="code" components={components} parentName="pre" props={{}}>{`<Bootstrap trackingData={{category:'default', page:'landing_page'}} >
</Bootstrap>
`}</MDXTag></MDXTag>
           </MDXTag>
  }
}
